protocol.comparisonChoice: Stay plus four nearby target/strength proposals
protocol.replaySchedule: Check activation after visit j while outer visit j+1 runs; apply before visit j+2.
protocol.sphereSemantics: The core has a fixed central address. The two nearest region centers are blended, so core use is possible outside its drawn radius.
protocol.geometryNote: The inner radius is 0.25 of outer radius. Its 5% parameter share is not a 5% geometric volume.

provenance.routeData: Fresh CPU FP32 inference replays of the saved checkpoint, identical delayed policy; not a GPU timing replay.
provenance.aggregateData: Previously saved full-512-example CUDA test evaluation; not the eight displayed examples.
provenance.selection: Eight evenly spaced sorted test program indices; assignment ordinal (3*i)%16, independent of predictions and turns.
provenance.limitations: One seed in an adaptive input-representation follow-up; reused benchmark holdouts; confidence intervals resample programs, not training seeds.
provenance.animation: Playback time is illustrative. Each exported cubic segment and region choice is measured.
